properties.headline: Flood Warning issued November 9 at 5:11PM CST until November 10 at 3:00PM CST by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in San Angelo has issued a Flood
Warning for the following rivers in Texas...

Llano River Near Mason affecting Mason County.

For the Llano River...including Junction, Mason...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Llano River near Mason.

* WHEN...From late tonight to Tuesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...At 18.0 feet, Minor lowland flooding will occur.
Secondary roads and low water crossings will become flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 5:00 PM CST Monday the stage was 16.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 11.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river will rise to 16.2 feet this evening. It will
then fall slightly to 16.0 feet this evening. It will then rise
above flood stage to 18.2 feet just after Midnight tonight. It
will then fall below flood stage after Midnight tonight.
- Flood stage is 18.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 18.4
feet on 07/12/1988.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued late tonight at 515 AM CST.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING IN EFFECT FROM LATE TONIGHT TO TUESDAY AFTERNOON

properties.headline: Coastal Flood Advisory issued November 9 at 11:57AM CST until November 10 at 3:00AM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding.

* WHERE...Coastal Aransas, Coastal Kleberg, Coastal Nueces,
Coastal San Patricio, Coastal Refugio and Coastal Calhoun
Counties.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM CST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected.
properties.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
